previous_statement: Cancellation-free lower modulus via the validated target addition inverse. Equip the fourfold target-corner direct sum with its max norm, put Z=Gamma_n(mu_n(X))=(gamma_jk,n(X_jk))_{j,k}, and write gamma_n(X)=alpha_n(Z). By the datum’s lower norm bounds and validated node 1.1.1, ||Z||_max=max_jk||gamma_jk,n(X_jk)|| >= (1-rho) max_jk||X_jk|| >= (1-rho)||X||/4. Validated node 1.1.2 supplies a universal M<infinity, independent of n, with ||alpha_n^{-1}||<=M; hence ||Z||_max=||alpha_n^{-1}(gamma_n(X))||<=M||gamma_n(X)|| and therefore ||gamma_n(X)|| >= (1-rho)||X||/(4M). The triangle inequality, the upper corner bounds, and node 1.1.1 also give ||gamma_n(X)||<=sum_jk(1+rho)||X_jk||<=4(1+rho)||X||. Restricting rho<=1/2 gives the asserted universal bounds with c_0=1/(8M) and upper constant 5. This proves the preliminary modulus without any separate assumption that the compression maps C_jk,n are uniformly bounded.
